property_summary: For any caller and any inputs, setL1BlockValues never changes the stored l1FeeScalar (the reference contract assigns nothing), so c.l1FeeScalar() must remain 0 after every call; the mutant stores the fuzzed _l1FeeScalar, breaking the rule when the caller is the depositor account (address(0)) with a nonzero scalar.
change_summary: Insert `l1FeeScalar = _l1FeeScalar;` after the require so the public getter l1FeeScalar() returns the passed value.
